notes: Provisional. The registry only accepts nonce == version + 1, so nonces must be renumbered against the live registry version at signing time; renumbering changes the digest.

Inputs of the EIP-712 digest. The digest binds the deployment id (domain salt) and the registry head the decision extends (prevHead): nonce 1 extends the genesis head, which commits to the initial committee, threshold, contact and notice periods given here; nonce n > 1 extends the digest of draft n - 1. These are placeholders for drafting: before signing, recompute every digest against the live registry (decisionDigest on the target registry, or build.py with that registry's deployment id and genesis inputs while it is still at version 0).

0 = as soon as the registry's CERT_NOTICE has passed after relay (effectiveFrom = max(effectiveAt, block.timestamp + CERT_NOTICE)).
